bb_jason-duval_r: Jason Duval is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6. A former soldier, he works for drug runners in the Leonida Keys when he meets Lucia Caminos.
bb_lucia-caminos_r: Lucia Caminos is the first playable female protagonist of a modern-era GTA. Fresh out of the Leonida Penitentiary, she wants the good life her mother dreams of, and Jason could be her way out.
bb_cal-hampton_r: Cal Hampton is Jason's friend and an associate of Brian Heder. A laid-back paranoid, he prefers staying home, snooping on Coast Guard comms with a few beers within reach.
bb_boobie-ike_r: Boobie Ike is a Vice City legend: a former street hustler turned businessman, he owns real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and funds the Only Raw Records label with Dre'Quan Priest.
bb_drequan-priest_r: Dre'Quan Priest is a young, ambitious Vice City producer and former dealer who co-runs the Only Raw Records label with Boobie Ike and has just signed the Real Dimez duo.
bb_real-dimez_r: Real Dimez is a Vice City rap duo, Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school, who went from social media to the Only Raw Records label after an early hit with rapper DWNPLY.
bb_raul-bautista_r: Raul Bautista is a seasoned, charming and confident bank robber, always hunting for recruits ready to take the risks that bring the biggest rewards. His recklessness raises the stakes with every score.
bb_brian-heder_r: Brian Heder is an old-school drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys. He still moves product through his boat yard with his third wife Lori, and lets Jason live rent-free in exchange for favors.
bb_vice-city_r: Vice City is the big city of Leonida and the heart of GTA 6: beaches, neon, skyscrapers, clubs and yachts. It is the return of the city from GTA Vice City (2002), fully rebuilt for the present day.
bb_leonida-keys_r: The Leonida Keys are the chain of islands in the south of the state, home turf of Jason Duval, Brian Heder and Cal Hampton. This is where Jason's story begins, between a boat yard and smuggling runs.
bb_grassrivers_r: Grassrivers is the wetlands region of Leonida: slow waters, airboats and alligators, a fictional take on the Everglades presented among the game's six official regions.
bb_port-gellhorn_r: Port Gellhorn is a port town on Leonida's Gulf coast, smaller and more worn than Vice City. It is one of the six official regions presented by Rockstar.
bb_ambrosia_r: Ambrosia is an inland town of Leonida, dominated by its sugar refinery and its fields. One of the game's six official regions.
bb_mount-kalaga_r: Mount Kalaga is the great natural park in the north of Leonida: forests, rivers, hunting and wide open spaces. One of the six official regions presented by Rockstar.
bb_editions_r: GTA 6 comes in two editions: Standard at $79.99 / €79.99 (boxed or digital) and Ultimate at $99.99 / €99.99 (digital only). Same story in both; the Ultimate adds vehicles, weapons and shops unlocked through the campaign.
bb_debuter_r: Before launching GTA 6 on November 19: what Rockstar has shown of the game (two playable leads, interiors, weapon wheel, radio on foot, six-star wanted level) and what the press learned at Rockstar North. A starter guide with no leaks.
bb_jason-duval_c1: Playable character, alongside Lucia Caminos (Rockstar, Trailer 2, May 6, 2025)
bb_jason-duval_c2: Grew up around grifters and crooks, then joined the Army to shake off his troubled teens
bb_jason-duval_c3: Lives in the Keys and works for local drug runners
bb_jason-duval_c4: Lives rent-free at one of Brian Heder's properties, in exchange for help with local shakedowns
bb_jason-duval_c5: Friend of Cal Hampton, also one of Brian's associates
bb_jason-duval_s1p: Rockstar presents Jason as a man who wants an easy life while things keep getting harder. Born among grifters, he tried the Army to straighten out, then came back to the Keys to do what he knows best: muscle work for drug runners. His official tagline: it might be time to try something new.
bb_jason-duval_s2t: What is his relationship with Lucia?
bb_jason-duval_s2p: According to Rockstar, meeting Lucia could be the best or the worst thing to ever happen to him. The couple is at the heart of the story: an easy score goes wrong and drags them into a conspiracy across the state of Leonida. Both are playable and, judging by the Extended Look released in August 2026, switching between them happens mid-action.
bb_jason-duval_s3p: Jason Schreier (Bloomberg, October 2026), hosted at Rockstar North, describes a story closer in tone to Red Dead Redemption 2 than to GTA V, focused on the duo, and a sweat system that marks clothes depending on effort. These details come from a journalist, not an official announcement.
bb_jason-duval_s4p: Rockstar has not named the actor who voices and portrays Jason. The names circulating come from fan lists: we do not publish them.
bb_lucia-caminos_c2: Her father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk
bb_lucia-caminos_c3: Sent to the Leonida Penitentiary for fighting for her family; sheer luck got her out
bb_lucia-caminos_c4: She and her mother lived in Liberty City before Leonida
bb_lucia-caminos_c5: She intends to take matters into her own hands instead of dreaming
bb_lucia-caminos_s1p: Rockstar presents her as a woman who has always had to fight. Loyalty to her family sent her to prison; she leaves it determined to make only smart moves from here. Trailer 1 opens on her interview in custody, and official images later show her wearing an ankle monitor.
bb_lucia-caminos_s2p: More than anything, the good life her mother has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. But instead of dreaming, Lucia plans to act. In the official description, only one thing matters: who you know and what you've got. A life with Jason could be her way out.
bb_lucia-caminos_s3p: Lucia is one of the two playable characters of GTA 6. It is the first time since the original GTA and its anonymous character roster that a woman holds the lead role in the series. In the Extended Look from August 2026, she takes part in shootouts and heists just like Jason.
bb_lucia-caminos_s4p: Rockstar has not announced who plays her. Actress Manni Perez is often cited by players, without official confirmation: we present this as a rumor, not a fact.
bb_cal-hampton_c1: Friend of Jason Duval and associate of Brian Heder in the Keys
bb_cal-hampton_c2: Feels safest at home, listening to Coast Guard frequencies
bb_cal-hampton_c3: Conspiracy fan: what if everything on the internet was true?
bb_cal-hampton_c4: Rockstar describes him as happy at the low tide of America
bb_cal-hampton_s1p: In the official gallery, Cal is the supporting character closest to Jason. He lives in the Keys, also works for Brian, and spends his days monitoring Coast Guard comms with a few private browser tabs open. His paranoia is described as casual: he loves sharing it, but his friend Jason has bigger plans.
bb_cal-hampton_s2t: What is his role in the story?
bb_cal-hampton_s2p: Rockstar has not detailed his missions. His profile suggests an informant and a listening ear for the Keys' smuggling: who is at sea, who is being watched. Everything else is unknown.
bb_cal-hampton_s3p: No official information on his past, his voice actor or his weight in the campaign. We will update this entry as soon as Rockstar or the press says more.
bb_boobie-ike_c1: Local Vice City legend who turned his street years into a legitimate empire
bb_boobie-ike_c2: Owns real estate, a strip club (the Jack of Hearts) and a recording studio
bb_boobie-ike_c3: Partner of young producer Dre'Quan Priest in the Only Raw Records label
bb_boobie-ike_c4: All smiles, until it's time to talk business
bb_boobie-ike_s1p: Rockstar presents him as one of the few who turned his time in the streets into a legitimate empire. Real estate, club, studio: Boobie is everywhere in the Vice City night, and he acts like a legend. His official line sums up the model: the club money pays for the studio, and the drug money pays for it all.
bb_boobie-ike_s2p: His main investment is his partnership with Dre'Quan for Only Raw Records. They need a hit, and that is where the Real Dimez come in. Boobie sits at the center of a musical, nocturnal Vice City storyline, distinct from Jason's life in the Keys.
bb_boobie-ike_s3p: Rockstar has not said how Jason and Lucia meet him, nor what missions he hands out. His actor has not been announced.
bb_drequan-priest_c1: More of a hustler than a gangster, according to Rockstar: music was always the goal
bb_drequan-priest_c2: Dealt on the streets to make ends meet
bb_drequan-priest_c3: Co-runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike
bb_drequan-priest_c4: Signed the Real Dimez and now targets the whole Vice City scene
bb_drequan-priest_s1p: In the official description, Dre'Quan was never a gangster by vocation: even while dealing, breaking into music remained the goal. He books acts into Boobie's club, but those days seem numbered now that he has signed the Real Dimez.
bb_drequan-priest_s2p: His official line: dancers are his A&Rs. If a record works in the club, DJs will spin it. That is the whole logic of Only Raw Records, between the night scene and social media.
bb_drequan-priest_s3p: His exact link to Jason and Lucia, his missions and his actor have not been announced.
bb_real-dimez_c1: Duo formed by Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school
bb_real-dimez_c2: Turned their time shaking down local dealers into cash, through spicy rap tracks and a relentless social media presence
bb_real-dimez_c3: Early hit single with local rapper DWNPLY
bb_real-dimez_c4: Five years and a lot of trouble later, signed to Only Raw Records
bb_real-dimez_s1p: Rockstar describes them in two phrases: viral videos, viral hooks. Bae-Luxe and Roxy had the savvy to monetize their street reputation into tracks and social content. Their hit with DWNPLY took them to new heights, then trouble came. Only Raw Records, Boobie and Dre'Quan's label, hopes lightning strikes twice.
bb_real-dimez_s2p: The duo sits at the heart of Vice City's music storyline. Rockstar has confirmed eight radio stations in the game, including a Southern rap one, Dirty South Classics: whether their tracks play there is still unknown.
bb_real-dimez_s3p: Their performers and their role in Jason and Lucia's missions have not been announced.
bb_raul-bautista_c1: Experienced bank robber, according to the official description
bb_raul-bautista_c2: Recruits talent ready to take big risks for big rewards
bb_raul-bautista_c3: His recklessness raises the stakes with every score: his crew will have to double down or walk away
bb_raul-bautista_s1p: Confidence, charm and cunning: that is how Rockstar sums him up. Raul is the professional robber of the cast. He is always looking for new partners, and Jason and Lucia, a couple in need of money, tick every box. His official line: life is full of surprises, we'd all be wise to remember that.
bb_raul-bautista_s2p: Official images show Jason and Lucia masked inside a vault, cash in the air. According to the demo given to Bloomberg at Rockstar North (October 2026), the game leans on improvised crime: walk into a bank to count the guards, give up, fall back on a gas station. Raul looks like the natural link to the big organized scores, but Rockstar has not said so explicitly.
bb_raul-bautista_s3p: His actor, the number of heists and their structure have not been announced.
bb_brian-heder_c1: Classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys
bb_brian-heder_c2: Runs a boat yard with Lori, his third wife, who helps him manage it
bb_brian-heder_c3: Lets others do his dirty work
bb_brian-heder_c4: Hosts Jason rent-free, as long as he helps with local shakedowns and stops by for Lori's sangria
bb_brian-heder_s1p: Rockstar describes him with an image: he looks like a Leonida beach bum, but moves like a great white shark. Brian hauled so much grass in his plane that, he says, he could make the state levitate. Today he stays in the background, behind his boat yard, and lets the young ones take the risks.
bb_brian-heder_s2p: He is Jason's boss at the start of the story. He lends him one of his properties, provided he helps with local shakedowns. Cal Hampton works for him too. The official page shows him cocktail in hand: nothing better than a Mudslide at sunset.
bb_brian-heder_s3p: Lori's exact role, the scope of Brian's missions and his actor have not been announced.
bb_vice-city_c1: Capital of the fictional state of Leonida, described by Rockstar as neon-soaked streets
bb_vice-city_c2: Already the setting of GTA Vice City (2002) and Vice City Stories (2006), in the 1980s
bb_vice-city_c3: Home turf of Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest and the Real Dimez
bb_vice-city_c4: Seen in Trailers 1 and 2 and in the Extended Look: highways, skyline, beach, clubs, skyscrapers
bb_vice-city_c5: The Vintage Vice City Pack (pre-order bonus) pays tribute to Tommy Vercetti's era
bb_vice-city_s1t: What is Vice City in GTA 6?
bb_vice-city_s1p: The official site presents it as the heart of Leonida, the sunshine state. Official images show a bay and skyline from the air, a packed highway, beaches, purple nightclubs and basketball players in Manatees jerseys. When the sun fades and the neon glows, says Rockstar, everyone has something to gain and more to lose.
bb_vice-city_s2p: Trailer 2 (May 2025) opens on Vice City and its beaches. The Extended Look from August 2026 shows a cover shootout in a city skyscraper, a six-star wanted level and explorable interiors. According to Bloomberg, Rockstar artists have been working on the map since 2015, with scouting trips to Miami.
bb_vice-city_s3p: Vice City points to Miami, as it did in 2002: the press recalls the influence of the Miami Vice series on the city's look. Rockstar does not name Miami.
bb_vice-city_s4p: The list of districts, the size of the map and the exact mission locations have not been announced. Names circulating come from leaks and do not appear here.
bb_leonida-keys_c1: Official region of Leonida, featured on Rockstar's site
bb_leonida-keys_c2: Jason works there for local drug runners
bb_leonida-keys_c3: Brian Heder runs his boat yard there, through which product still moves
bb_leonida-keys_c4: Official images: archipelago from the air, turquoise water, bridges between the islands
bb_leonida-keys_s1p: A chain of islands linked by bridges, at the very south of the map, in the image of the Florida Keys the name evokes. Rockstar makes it the setting of the golden age of smuggling: Brian Heder claims to have hauled enough grass by plane to make the state levitate.
bb_leonida-keys_s2p: Jason lives in a property lent by Brian. Cal Hampton listens to the Coast Guard from home. Lori, Brian's third wife, manages the boat yard. Jason's first missions likely take place here, but Rockstar has not said so.
bb_leonida-keys_s3p: The number of islands, the villages, water activities and the size of the region have not been announced.
bb_grassrivers_c1: Official region of Leonida, listed by Rockstar among the must-see destinations
bb_grassrivers_c2: Official image: marshes, channels and wildlife, including alligators
bb_grassrivers_c3: The trailers show airboats and wild animals (alligators, flamingos)
bb_grassrivers_s1p: The state's great wetland. Official visuals show expanses of grass and water, airboats and alligators. The Back Country station, confirmed by Rockstar, describes itself as airboat-ready country: a hint at the region's mood.
bb_grassrivers_s2p: The trailers show alligators, flamingos, birds in formation and a local on a flamingo float in a pool. Rockstar has not detailed the hunting system or interactions with animals.
bb_grassrivers_s3p: Activities, missions and villages of Grassrivers have not been announced.
bb_port-gellhorn_c1: Official region of Leonida, featured on Rockstar's site
bb_port-gellhorn_c2: Official image: waterfront, motels and shops of a seaside resort from another time
bb_port-gellhorn_s1p: A seaside town whose glory days are behind it: a faded resort mood, bars, motels and docks. It is the counterpoint to Vice City and its neon.
bb_port-gellhorn_s2p: Trailer 2 and official visuals show its streets and coast. Rockstar has published no long text about the town.
bb_port-gellhorn_s3p: Its characters, missions and activities have not been announced.
bb_ambrosia_c1: Official region of Leonida, featured on Rockstar's site
bb_ambrosia_c2: Official image: countryside, refinery and chimneys at sunset
bb_ambrosia_s1p: A working-class inland town, far from the beaches, built around the sugar industry. Official visuals show a refinery, an American flag and late-day light.
bb_ambrosia_s2p: Rockstar has published nothing about its residents or the missions set there.
bb_mount-kalaga_c1: Official region of Leonida, featured on Rockstar's site
bb_mount-kalaga_c2: Official image: river, dense forest and hills
bb_mount-kalaga_s1p: Leonida's national park, in the north of the map. Official visuals show a forest-lined river and hills: the wild side of the state, the opposite of Vice City.
bb_mount-kalaga_s2p: Hunting, fishing, animals and activities have not been detailed by Rockstar. We will update as soon as an official announcement arrives.
bb_editions_c1: Release on November 19, 2026 on PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and S; no PC version announced
bb_editions_c2: Standard: $79.99 / €79.99, the full game, boxed or digital
bb_editions_c3: Ultimate: $99.99 / €99.99, digital only, same story plus bonuses
bb_editions_c4: Ultimate bonuses: Grotti Cheetah, Shitzu Squalo, 1967 Vapid Dominator Buggy, Dinka Enduro, Crest Kayak; Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers; Sara's Unisex Salon, Electric Fang, One-Eyed Willie's, Goodtime Gear, Stock 305; Wyman's Classic Car Collection
bb_editions_c5: Pre-order (open since June 25, 2026): Vintage Vice City Pack for everyone, and one month of GTA+ for digital orders
bb_editions_c6: The physical box contains a download code, no disc
bb_editions_c7: Preload from November 12, 2026; PEGI 18 / ESRB M
bb_editions_s1p: The Standard is enough to play the whole story: both editions share the same campaign. The Ultimate, sold digitally only, spreads its bonuses across the chapters of Jason and Lucia's story: cars and a boat, two revolvers, exclusive shops and a collection of classic cars to restore. Rockstar lets you upgrade from Standard to Ultimate later for the difference. PCMag (October 2026) advises starting with the Standard.
bb_editions_s2p: Every pre-order, Standard included, gets the Vintage Vice City Pack: a 1955 Vapid Stanier, a garage in Ocean Beach, 1980s outfits and weapon patterns inspired by Tommy Vercetti. The pack remains free for anyone buying before November 20. Digital pre-orders add one month of GTA+.
bb_editions_s3p: No box contains a disc: only a code. Preload opens on November 12, 2026. Rockstar has announced neither a PC version nor a date for one; the dates circulating are rumors, tracked in our Verdict of the 19th.
bb_editions_s4p: The download size and the exact unlock time have not been announced.
bb_debuter_c1: Two playable characters, Jason and Lucia, with mid-action switching (Extended Look, August 2026)
bb_debuter_c2: Six-star wanted level and cover shootouts inside buildings
bb_debuter_c3: Eight radio stations, also playable on foot through the phone's earphones
bb_debuter_c4: Preload from November 12, 2026, release on the 19th on PS5 and Xbox Series
bb_debuter_c5: Extended Look footage was captured on PS5
bb_debuter_s1t: What does the Extended Look show?
bb_debuter_s1p: The 26-minute video released in late August 2026, first on Netflix then on YouTube, is the only official gameplay footage. It shows a cover shootout in a Vice City skyscraper, an instant switch from Jason to Lucia, a six-star wanted level, conversations, dialogue choices and backyard wrestling as a side activity. Everything was captured on a standard PS5.
bb_debuter_s2p: According to Bloomberg and JeuxVideo.com (October 2026), Rob Nelson of Rockstar North speaks of hundreds of small interiors accessible from the street: banks, convenience stores, back rooms, a gym. Not every building. Scouting becomes a gameplay move: walk in, count the guards, walk away or act.
bb_debuter_s3p: Jason Schreier reports that Rockstar spent years testing other menus, inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2 and its limited weapon count, before returning to the classic wheel. Expect the usual interface, with fewer weapons carried.
bb_debuter_s4p: Six stations were confirmed by Rockstar on October 8, 2026 (Flash FM, Cocoteo, Back Country, Afro Bank FM, The Chamber, Dirty South Classics) and two more spotted by the press (Vice City FM, V-Rock FM). Radio and podcasts follow you on foot through earphones linked to Jason and Lucia's phone.
bb_debuter_s5p: Preload from November 12. The official site lists the game on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; no PC. Pick your edition on our Editions and prices entry. Everything we don't know (exact time, download size) is stated as unknown, and updated as soon as it is announced.
